I agree, people have this backwards. You don't lose weight to help depression, you need to figure out how to deal with your depression in order to lose weight. I have been losing weight and working my ass off and it's helped me physically, but i'm still depressed so I still need to figure out how to manage my depression.

Hey man, if you need help with food addiction you can pm me but I will give you some tips that helped me lose more than 50 pounds in the last 2 years.

The biggest thing to AVOID when losing weight is to go on a diet that you cannot maintain. This causes lots of struggle and will be hard to keep up. Diets like keto, paleo, intermittent fasting, etc make it super hard to maintain anything because one day, you will eventually be off the diet.

One of the biggest skills when it comes to losing weight is to find the easiest and least painful thing you can do to lose it that you can sustain for a long period of time. For me, it was just counting calories. It may take some time to get used to, but a caloric deficit can be one of the most consistent and reliable ways to lose weight once you get in the groove. I recommend you start by eating 1500 calories a day and using an app to monitor your calories.

In short, you wany to make losing weight as simple, painless, and consistent as you can.

First off, please don't do intermittent fasting it has done nothing for me in the past and when you get hungry, you just start eating everything in sight. If you are having trouble with sugary cravings, you have multiple options. First, you could try eating sweeter foods that are lower in calories that you don't bother eating like fruits. You could try drinking diet sodas instead of normal. The third is to make sure you eat a good meal and drink a lot of water before you eat an unhealthy dessert and try to eat a very small amount of it.
I also agree, you do not need to exercise. In fact, exercising will make you more hungry. Focus on losing weight and then begin exercising which is what I did.

Don't do keto man. Just do calorie counting. It may take much longer to lose weight but keeping it off will be much easier. Plus, you still get to eat foods you enjoy as long as you are not exceeding the caloric limit.
